title: Swiipt Research Opportunity Record
description: Structured output of the research agent - replaces prose reports as the source of truth ('do NOT make the LLM the database'). Derived from Standard v1 section 2A (research finding definition), section 3 (no-research-wasted rule + 13 library roles), Gate 0 (research disposition), and the prompt.md six-stage framework including the survival-pain test (3-of-5 rule). A research finding is NOT automatically a product.

opportunity_id.description: Stable id (convention fixed with the record store, factory build item 4).

source.description: Provenance: e.g. 'agent-reach:reddit', 'websearch', 'owner-interview', 'library-report', 'competitor-review'. Free string so new channels never break the schema.

source_references.description: URLs / citations backing the finding. Required for findings whose evidence_basis claims sourced status downstream.

life_area.description: Canonical life-area slug m01-m24 (matches the live platform's life_area taxonomy).

submarket.description: One report per submarket was the old manual rule; each submarket run yields one or more opportunity records.

finding.description: The raw discovery, expressed in situation-hierarchy terms where known (section 4.2). Fields may be partially unknown at capture time; the situation gate (Gate 1) demands completeness only before transformation candidacy.

evidence_quotes.description: Verbatim customer-voice quotes; keep provenance in source_references.

survival_pain_test.description: prompt.md Stage-1 Survival-Level Pain Test - the five canonical criteria verbatim. Passes at 3-of-5 YES. A failed test does NOT discard the finding - it informs the disposition (sections 3 and 22).

urgency.description: Must this be solved now, not later?

embarrassment.description: Is this too shameful to discuss openly?

failed_attempts.description: Have people already tried other fixes that didn't work?

identity_threat.description: Does it threaten who they are (as a man, mother, provider, professional)?

immediate_spend.description: Would the entry price feel like a no-brainer for this pain?

signals_observed.description: Why each true flag was marked - evidence, not vibes.

disposition.description: Gate 0 outcome. Required once status leaves 'open'. The only terminal state is RETAINED + ASSIGNED ROLE - there is no DISCARD.

promoted_transformation_id.description: Set when the disposition is STANDALONE_TRANSFORMATION (or later promotion) and a candidate transformation record exists.

reclassification_history.description: Findings can be reclassified as new evidence arrives; history is kept, never erased.

status.description: Lifecycle of the finding inside the factory. 'promoted_to_candidate' means a transformation record now carries this forward.

related_opportunity_ids.description: Duplicate/overlap tracking feeds the section 24 overlap test (same situation nucleus must not spawn duplicate products).

provenance.description: DESCRIPTIVE research provenance (task research-pipeline V1 Phase B). Records where the research came from; it never defines transformation identity or applicability. Unknown values stay null.

source_label.description: Human/document identifier of the source corpus.

source_date.description: Date the source states for the research (never invented).

population.description: Population/cohort the research represents, if stated.

geography.description: Geography the research was collected in, if stated.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction whose law/regulation is engaged, if any.

applicability.description: ANALYTICAL applicability determination (Phase C). Distinct from provenance: it decides whether the transformation contract materially depends on geography/culture/jurisdiction.
